notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary project-table values, not independently converted. Original full HTML author-uploaded paper verified. No single original pooled effect is printed; es.value left null instead of computing a pooled correlation. Printed components: age-18 NEM with age-21 conflict: .33* (.33*); age-26 concurrent conflict: .32* (.30*). Parentheses denote partial correlations controlling gender and same/new partner. All listed component tests have p < .01. No individual narrative success verdict located; numeric success coding is not treated as narrative.
Completion source review (n_r): Table 1 explicitly lists one test and its replication sample size. No arithmetic or recruitment-total substitution.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed observed effect .01, corrected effect .01 retained in notes. Generic printed metric retained; r versus standardized coefficient is not independently distinguishable per row. No metric or sign conversion.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly label column replication success rate, observed/corrected 0/0. Observed author summary mapped to failed; corrected summary retained in notes. No new significance-based verdict.
